spec.name: Orange Kitchen Spicy Ramen
spec.description: A deep, stepped terracotta ramen bowl with a glossy ivory rim, fiery broth, curled golden noodles, a soft egg and two wooden chopsticks. Grounded at y=0 with a clear, appetizing inventory silhouette.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Spicy Ramen. Deep glazed ceramic ramen/rice bowl, visible noodles or rice, discrete appropriate ingredient toppings and chopsticks. Actual recipe ingredients: broth, noodles, hot sauce, egg. Let the visible appearance reflect these ingredients.
